purpose: gpu/hwcodec PRODUCTION (opus-cam): /usr/local/libexec/vcodecd + the phone's own five vendor codec objects in /usr/local/lib/n2vendor/{bin,lib}; launchd job com.nord2.vcodecd (RunAtLoad, KeepAlive on failure, --restart-on-switch) gated by /private/var/db/nord2-vcodec-run; no test jobs. Undo: guest-vcodec-undo.sh. Plus VideoToolbox plug-ins Slim.videodecoder, Slim.videoencoder (hardware paths behind nord2-video-claim-hw / nord2-video-hwdec). | big-prod4 (opus-robust, 12 Nov): payload-vcodec-prod3 with the same gates, job arguments and switches; new Slim.videodecoder (StartSession falls back in-object to the next VideoToolbox decoder, H264SW/VCPHEVC, when the hardware session cannot be opened: daemon absent, BUSY/RESTART after 1 s of retries, OPEN/DEC_HEADER refused, 10-bit/4:2:2/interlaced; relay requests serialised per process; CLOSE after a failed StartSession) and new vcodecd (vcodecd.log capped at 4 MiB + one .1 backup; per-picture decode START lines rate-limited; also contains the B12 heap-zero fix of the tree). Slim.videoencoder and the vendor objects are byte-identical to prod3. HARDWARE_CODECS.md section 7.
